summary: Destroys a singly-linked list. Walks each node, and for nodes whose flag byte at offset 0x8 is non-zero, runs SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling on the node's data pointer before freeing the data. Frees every node, then clears the container's head, tail, iterator and count fields to zero and returns 0.

operations.description: Guard on the head pointer at this+0x0; when null the list is empty and the walk is skipped.
Iterate the singly-linked list from the head node, following each node's next pointer at node offset 0x4 until a null next pointer ends the walk.
For each node, test the flag byte at node offset 0x8; a non-zero flag marks the node's data as SEH-managed.
Test the node's data pointer at offset 0x0; the data is freed only when it is non-null.
Run SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling on the flagged node's data pointer, invoking its registered cleanup under the exception handler registered at global 0x0059CDE8.
FreeWrapper_7bcf releases the node's data memory.
FreeWrapper_7bcf releases the node memory itself after the data cleanup.
Zero the container fields: head (this+0x0), tail (this+0x4), iterator (this+0x8) and node count (this+0xC) are all cleared to 0.
Return 0 after the list has been emptied.
